questions.title: What happens if you play the wrong ball and finish the hole?
questions.question: If you hit someone else’s ball by mistake and keep playing it until you finish the hole, what happens?

choices.text: You get four extra shots added
You need to play the hole again
You are out of the game

questions.explanation: If you play a hole with the wrong ball and don’t fix it, you are out of the game for that round.

vocabulary.simpleMeaning: A ball that is not your own, like another player’s ball.
You have to stop playing in the game or round.

questions.teachingTip: Help children mark their own balls with a special mark so they do not play the wrong one.
likelyMisconceptions: Children might think they can just add penalty shots if they finish the hole with a wrong ball.
Children may believe they can fix the mistake after the hole is done.

questions.question: What is the result if you finish a hole without correcting your mistake of playing the wrong ball?
questions.explanation: If you fail to correct your mistake and finish the hole with a wrong ball, you are disqualified.
